name: 반딧불 숲 공터
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly forest clearing filled with drifting fireflies glowing softly above a fallen log seat, tall trees encircling the open space; wide eye-level composition, open lower-central foreground, cool teal twilight glow mixed with warm amber firefly light, dewy grass, scattered leaves, layered woodland depth, magical fantasy concept art, richly atmospheric lighting, gentle drifting pollen catching the glow.
